metaData.title: Introducing the Ettin Reranker Family
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Hugging Face releases six new state-of-the-art CrossEncoder rerankers built on Ettin ModernBERT encoders, offering a complete training recipe and demonstrating strong performance across MTEB benchmarks with up to 8K token context support.
metaData.summary: This blog post announces the release of six new Sentence Transformers CrossEncoder rerankers, ranging from 17M to 1B parameters, built on the Ettin ModernBERT encoder suite from Johns Hopkins University. The models are trained using a distillation recipe with pointwise MSE loss, distilling from the mixedbread-ai/mxbai-rerank-large-v2 teacher. The post provides a comprehensive overview including architecture details (ModernBERT backbone with unpadded attention, RoPE, GeGLU, and a 4-module classification head), usage examples with just 3 lines of code, and an end-to-end retrieve-then-rerank pipeline. Extensive benchmark results on MTEB(eng, v2) Retrieval and NanoBEIR show the models achieve state-of-the-art performance at their respective sizes, with the 1B model closely matching its 1.54B teacher. The 17M model beats the 33M ms-marco-MiniLM-L12-v2 by +0.051 NDCG@10 on MTEB, and the 32M model outperforms the 568M BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 by +0.025. Speed benchmarks on H100 GPUs are also provided, along with recommendations for using Flash Attention 2 and bfloat16 for optimal throughput. All models are released under Apache 2.0 license.

mainPoints.point: Six new rerankers from 17M to 1B parameters achieve state-of-the-art performance at their respective sizes.
mainPoints.explanation: Built on Ettin ModernBERT encoders, the models demonstrate strong results on MTEB and NanoBEIR benchmarks, with the 1B model closely matching its 1.54B teacher and the 17M model outperforming larger legacy models.

mainPoints.point: The training recipe uses distillation from a strong teacher with pointwise MSE loss on a curated dataset.
mainPoints.explanation: The models are distilled from mixedbread-ai/mxbai-rerank-large-v2 using scores over a combination of pre-training and fine-tuning datasets, with the recipe fully disclosed for reproducibility.

mainPoints.point: All models support up to 8K token context and are optimized for production use with Flash Attention 2.
mainPoints.explanation: ModernBERT's long-context pre-training enables reranking of long documents, and the architecture supports unpadded attention for variable-length inputs, achieving 1.7x-8.3x speedup over default loading.

mainPoints.point: The smallest models offer compelling quality-to-parameter ratios for production retrieve-then-rerank pipelines.
mainPoints.explanation: The 17M and 32M models significantly outperform legacy MiniLM rerankers while being smaller, making them ideal drop-in replacements for existing stacks.

keyQuotes: The retriever decides what enters the funnel, the reranker decides what wins.
The smallest model I'm releasing, our 17M, beats the 33M ms-marco-MiniLM-L12-v2 by +0.051 NDCG@10 ... at roughly half the parameter count.
Our 1B model closely tracks its teacher. It comes within 0.0001 of the 1.54B mxbai-rerank-large-v2 on MTEB.
If you've been using one of the legacy MiniLM rerankers as the default in your retrieve-then-rerank stack, swapping in our 17M (or 32M) is a low-risk drop-in replacement.

relatedArticles.title: Specialization Beats Scale: A Strategic Variable Most AI Procurement Decisions Overlook
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: A 3-billion-parameter specialized model outperformed every commercial frontier API in a structured OCR benchmark at roughly fifty times lower cost, demonstrating that distributional alignment to the deployment task can be more decisive than parameter count.

relatedArticles.title: Granite Embedding Multilingual R2: Open Apache 2.0 Multilingual Embeddings with 32K Context — Best Sub-100M Retrieval Quality
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: IBM releases two new Apache 2.0 multilingual embedding models built on ModernBERT, featuring a 97M compact model that leads its size class and a 311M full-size model with top-tier retrieval quality and 32K context.

relatedArticles.title: Training and Finetuning Multimodal Embedding & Reranker Models with Sentence Transformers
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides a comprehensive, hands-on guide to training and finetuning multimodal embedding and reranker models using the Sentence Transformers library, demonstrated through a practical case study of finetuning a 2B parameter model for Visual Document Retrieval.

relatedArticles.title: Introducing NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni: Long-Context Multimodal Intelligence for Documents， Audio and Video Agents
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: NVIDIA introduces Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, a new open-weight omni-modal model that combines text, image, video, and audio understanding with a hybrid Mamba-Transformer-MoE backbone, achieving top accuracy on multiple multimodal leaderboards while delivering up to 9x higher throughput.

relatedArticles.title: Falcon Perception
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Falcon Perception is a 0.6B early-fusion Transformer that unifies vision and language in a single backbone for open-vocabulary grounding and segmentation, outperforming SAM 3 on complex compositional prompts.

relatedArticles.title: Building a Fast Multilingual OCR Model with Synthetic Data
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details NVIDIA's development of Nemotron OCR v2, a fast and accurate multilingual OCR model trained on a massive, open-source synthetic dataset of 12.2 million images, overcoming data scarcity through a scalable, language-agnostic rendering pipeline.

relatedArticles.title: Multimodal Embedding & Reranker Models with Sentence Transformers
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Sentence Transformers v5.4 introduces native multimodal support, enabling seamless encoding and reranking of text, images, audio, and video through a unified API.

relatedArticles.title: How NVIDIA AI-Q Reached \#1 on DeepResearch Bench I and II
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: NVIDIA AI-Q achieves state-of-the-art performance on deep research benchmarks through a modular multi-agent architecture, fine-tuned Nemotron-3 models, and specialized reliability middleware.
